I have repaired the WAL file and extracted all 11 records into [recovered.json](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jt5f2i3_/recovered.json).

### Cause & Fix
- **Issue**: Every byte of [main.db-wal](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jt5f2i3_/main.db-wal) was XOR-encrypted with `0x42` (e.g., the SQLite WAL magic header `0x377f0682` appeared as `0x753d44c0`).
- **Resolution**:
  1. Decrypted [main.db-wal](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jt5f2i3_/main.db-wal) by XORing each byte with `0x42`, restoring valid WAL headers and frame checksums.
  2. Queried [main.db](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jt5f2i3_/main.db) with the repaired WAL to recover all 11 records (including the updated values for `id` 1 and 2 and newly inserted rows `id` 6 through 11).
  3. Wrote the sorted records to [recovered.json](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-jt5f2i3_/recovered.json).
